g.text: Why does the coupon save10 fail at checkout?
normalize() in src/coupon.mjs returns the code as typed, so
Making it upper case there fixes it.
ask a bot or a teammate
Runs on @laptop in shop. Type below to write to it there.
Start with @here to ask your agent here.
Making it upper case there fixes it.
Do spaces around the code break it too?
Do spaces around the code break it too?
Yes. A space before or after the code fails the same way.
ana asks her agent a question on her laptop.
ben's desk computer lists it under On laptop · ana.
ben writes to that session from his desk.
The laptop's agent answers. ben reads it at his desk.
On the laptop, ana sees ben's message and the answer.
